name: B10-0178/2025 (The Left) – Unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Azerbaijan to release all Armenian prisoners, hostages and other detainees held unlawfully, including former leaders from Nagorno-Karabakh. It condemns their trials as unfair and secretive, with made-up charges. It asks Azerbaijan to treat prisoners humanely and to let aid groups visit them. It wants European Union institutions to ban entry for Azerbaijani officials blamed for unlawful detentions and human rights abuses. It also urges the International Criminal Court to investigate forced displacement and ethnic cleansing of Armenians.

- The Parliament asks Azerbaijan to free detainees and ban abusive officials from European Union buildings; it cannot enforce this itself.
- It affects Armenian prisoners, Azerbaijani officials named in the text, and the International Criminal Court.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union institutions and Azerbaijan's government; it is a formal request, not a law.
